1.title: Pentagon Changes How It Reports Casualties in Iran War
1.summary: The changes separated the casualty numbers into two separate web pages, potentially making it more difficult to tally the war’s full toll.

2.title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
2.summary: Police said they engaged in a high-speed car chase but failed to arrest the suspect, who remains at large. Three people were arrested in June after a similar attack.

3.title: Bryan Kohberger, Convicted in Idaho College Killings, Seeks to Take Back Guilty Plea
3.summary: In an interview from prison, Bryan Kohberger said he had filed a petition to reopen the case. He blamed his guilty plea on ‘false promises’ and wrong information.

4.title: Wildfires Live Updates: Spain and France Fight to Contain Blazes as Extreme Heat Threatens New Fires
4.summary: Firefighters in eastern Spain were working to hold back a worsening wildfire on Monday. The crisis has forced hundreds of thousands to evacuate in central Spain and southwest France.

5.title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ Protesters Disperse, But Questions Remain on Education and Dissent
5.summary: The ‘Cockroach’ movement dispersed, saying its demands had been met, but there are larger issues about the country’s education system and the future of dissent.
